title: OpenAI sets out six pillars for safer teen AI use in Australia
friendlyTitle: OpenAI proposes six safety rules for young Australians using AI
summary: OpenAI’s Australian Youth Safety Blueprint proposes AI literacy, age-appropriate safeguards, privacy-preserving age assurance, crisis-support links, parental controls and company accountability. It follows the August rollout of a default ChatGPT experience for Australian users identified as 13 to 17.
friendlySummary: The plan covers AI education, safer settings, age checks, crisis help, parent controls and company responsibility. ChatGPT has also started using special defaults for Australian teenagers.
whyItMatters: The blueprint offers a concrete checklist for schools, parents, policymakers and product teams evaluating teen-facing AI. Its real value will depend on measurable implementation, especially how age checks protect privacy and how reliably high-risk conversations reach human help.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Parents and schools can use the six areas as a checklist. They should still ask how the promises work in practice and what personal data age checks require.
